extracted.name: All Purpose Marinade
extracted.description: This is an amazing and simple marinade that is perfect for shrimp, chicken, pork and beef.
ingredient_lines: 1 block Achiote Paste (can find at most specialty stores)
instruction_lines: In a blender add your shallots, garlic, cumin, lime juice and olive oil
In a mixing bowl crumble the Achiote Paste
Add your blended ingredients to the Achiote and Mix
Add contents of the bowl back into the blender and blend until well incorporated
Store in any container and refrigerate the marinade, this will last a few weeks refrigerated.
This is what the Achiote paste looks like before it's crumbled.
